buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) The bidder shall possess a valid licence under the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 (PS ARA), authorising the provision of security services at the place of deployment i.e Imphal, Manipur. A copy of the valid licence shall be submitted along with the bid. (2) The successful service provider may retain the existing contractual personnel identified in the retention list uploaded with the bid, subject to their willingness, statutory eligibility and the terms and conditions of t he contract. (3) The service provider shall ensure timely payment of wages to the deployed personnel through their res pective bank accounts within the prescribed statutory time limit. Payment of wages shall not be withheld o n account of pending payment of invoices by the Buyer. (4) Submission of Monthly Documents The service provider shall submit the following documents, wherever applicable, along with each monthly i nvoice: a) Wage slips and proof of payment of wages through bank accounts. b) EPF challans and employee-wise Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR), EDLI contributions, etc. (5) The service provider shall comply with all applicable labour laws, EPF, EDLI, ESI, bonus and other statu tory requirements. The service provider shall be responsible for any liability arising out of non-compliance on its part. 6. Recovery and Contractual Action In the event of non-payment of wages, non-deposit of statutory contributions, unauthorised absence, short deployment or other contractual defaults, the Buyer reserves the right to initiate applicable deductions, re coveries, penalties, performance security invocation, incident reporting or termination proceedings in acco rdance with the GeM GTC, SLA and applicable laws. 7. In lieu of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), bidders shall submit a duly signed Bid Securing Declaration, in
accordance with Rule 170(iii) of GFR, 2017. Non-submission of the mandatory declaration shall render the bid non-responsive and liable for rejection, subject to applicable exemptions. .
